articles.title: Brandon King leads West Indies to 8-wicket win over Bangladesh in 1st test
articles.description: Opener Brandon King hit an unbeaten 81 as West Indies chased down 170 with ease to beat Bangladesh by eight wickets in the first cricket test. Bangladesh was bowled out for 142 in the second innings, taking a lead of just 169 runs after losing nine wickets to West Indies spinners. Skipper Roston Chase claimed 5-36 with his wily offspin and left-arm spinner Jomel Warrican followed his 5-53 with 4-63 in the second innings. Resuming the day at 79-6, Bangladesh was able to add just 63 runs with Nayeem Hasan scoring most of them.
